description: This file defines the RecipeRepository class, which provides access to recipe data, supports searching, and manages user favorites via SharedPreferences. It acts as a singleton, offering methods to retrieve recipes, search through them, and toggle favorites.

classes.name: RecipeRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing recipe data and user favorites, implemented as a thread-safe singleton.

methods.name: getAllRecipes
methods.description: Returns the list of all recipes.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches recipes by a query string, matching title, description, or ingredients.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a recipe by its unique ID.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a recipe ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status for a recipe ID, adding or removing it from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getFavorites
methods.description: Returns the list of recipes marked as favorites.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RecipeRepository, initializing it if necessary.
